title: Movie Writer creates undeletable OGV file on Windows 11
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

So, Movie Writer needs to closed with the X button on the window and not the stop button at the top of the editor, but there is no "X" when the project is embedded and not floating, so I used the stop button anyway. Not only did this result in an output file that my computer couldn't open in a video player, but I literally cannot delete the .ogv output files (I could delete the unreadable .avi output file).

I have tried:
- closing godot and restarting my computer
- deleting the files from the windows file explorer
- using github desktop to discard the uncommited changes
- using powershell to `rm` the files

Results:
- didn't help
- the deletion popup loaded forever
- github desktop silently failed to discard the changes
- powershell hung up forever

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set movie writer output path to an .ogv file.
2. Turn on movie writer
3. Start project
4. Press the square stop sign to stop the project
5. Try to delete the .ogv file
